intro: Lesson 19: Sawm: the spirit of fasting and preparing for Ramadan; short quiz. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

panels.title: Fasting builds taqwa
points: Purpose: 'so that you may attain taqwa' (2:183)
Obeying Allah when no one sees
Self-control over food, anger and words

head: An empty fast
A full fast
rows: No food, but lying and arguing

keywords.def: awareness of Allah that makes us obey Him
the Night of Power, better than a thousand months (97:3)

questions.q: Turn 'I want a good Ramadan' into a SMART goal for character.
questions.a: For example: 'Each day of Ramadan, when I feel angry I will say "I am fasting" and stay silent, and I will count how often I manage it.'

questions.q: Short quiz (Teams Forms, 10 questions): 1) Year of Hudaybiyyah? 2) Ayah of the pledge? 3) One term of the treaty? 4) Who arrived in chains? 5) Ayah 'a clear victory'? 6) Year of the conquest? 7) Ayah recited at the idols? 8) Ayah 'consult them'? 9) Does forgetting break the fast? 10) Who pays fidyah?
questions.a: 1) 6 AH 2) 48:18 3) Any of the four terms 4) Abu Jandal 5) 48:1 6) 8 AH 7) 17:81 8) 3:159 9) No 10) Someone who can never fast

questions.q: In the portal response box, write your Ramadan plan: one character goal, one Qur'an goal, one act of giving, each specific and realistic.
questions.a: Three SMART goals rooted in the Sunnah.

questions.q: Stretch: explain 'fasting is a shield' in your own words.
questions.a: It protects from sin in this life by training self-control, and from the Fire in the next.

questions.q: Which is the best Ramadan goal?
options: Read two pages of Qur'an with meaning every day
Read the whole Qur'an on the first day only
Fast but stay up all night gaming
questions.a: A) Read two pages of Qur'an with meaning every day. Small and regular is most beloved to Allah. One huge burst then stopping, or neglecting prayer, misses the spirit.

questions.q: What is Laylat al-Qadr better than?
Think again: how can a fast gain nothing?
questions.a: If the person keeps lying, arguing or doing wrong while fasting.
